5 of 7 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Executive Session: CEO Performance Review

The Executive Session: CEO Performance Review was a review of the company's compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). The committee reviewed the company's accommodation process and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To approve for growth: RESOLVED, that the EMEA Leadership Council shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Yusuf Bullock  •  Seconded: Lucy Nishimura
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY2003

The committee considered the Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY2003 as presented by Vincent Goodman. The analysis in Exhibit B highlighted a need for policy changes to align with new regulations. After discussion of the implementation challenges, the committee voted to approve the new policy framework.

Motion

To establish: RESOLVED, that the EMEA Leadership Council adopts the revised Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY2003 policy, which shall supersede all prior policies on this matter, effective immediately.

Moved: Onur Asante  •  Seconded: Kayla Clark
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review

The committee discussed the Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review, a review of the company's political and lobbying activities. The committee approved the lobbying disclosure report for the previous quarter.

Motion

To authorize, subject to conditions: RESOLVED, that the EMEA Leadership Council approves the divestiture of the Esports Organizations business unit to Skyridge Advisors for a total consideration of $98M.

Moved: Kayla Clark  •  Seconded: Vincent Goodman
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
